lede:
Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin is new to Open Cabinet. His first tracked filings report 89 transactions — all sales, every one flagged as filed late.

The sales are dated between April 15 and June 10, 2026, the months after his March 24 confirmation. His filings also carry an Integrity.gov notice of a 45-day extension, so trades flagged late may still have been reported within his deadline.

Office of Personnel Management Director Scott A. Kupor reported four sales dated June 18, in Robinhood and Okta, valued at up to $5 million.
note: Scoped to the filings ingested 2026-07-25 (Mullin, Kupor). Every figure verified against the dataset: Mullin 89 transactions, all sales, all late-flagged, 2026-04-15 to 2026-06-10, confirmed 2026-03-24; Kupor four sales dated 2026-06-18.
